Skills stay first every session. Use enough band help on the bar drill to keep every turnover clean, and stop any skill set as soon as speed, symmetry or balance quality drops.

Weeks 2-4: bar-muscle-up assistance comes down, handstand attempts/support work climb a little, and the push-pull-leg foundation nudges up while staying submaximal. Week 4 keeps the best Week-3 standard with fewer total sets.

If you feel sharp wrist, elbow, shoulder or knee pain, stop that drill right away. For bar work add assistance immediately; for handstands cut the attempt count or hold time; for pistols reduce the rep target that day. Normal muscle effort is fine, joint pain or obvious technique change is not.
